fields.sentence: Rekisterinpitäjän on toteutettava tekniset toimenpiteet siirron mahdollistamiseksi.
fields.meaning: The controller must implement technical measures to enable the transfer.

fields.sentence: Siirto on tehtävä yleisesti käytetyssä koneluettavassa muodossa.
fields.meaning: The transfer must be made in a commonly used machine-readable format.

fields.sentence: Rekisterinpitäjä voi veloittaa kohtuullisen maksun toistuvista pyynnöistä.
fields.meaning: The controller may charge a reasonable fee for repeated requests.
The first data request is usually free.
The fee may be a maximum of 25 euros.

fields.sentence: Tietopyyntöön on vastattava ilman aiheetonta viivytystä.
fields.meaning: A data request must be answered without undue delay.

fields.sentence: Vastausaika on yksi kuukausi pyynnön esittämisestä.
fields.meaning: The response time is one month from the submission of the request.

fields.sentence: Määräaikaa voidaan jatkaa enintään kahdella kuukaudella.
fields.meaning: The deadline may be extended by a maximum of two months.
The extension must be notified to the data subject.
The controller must justify any refusal.
A refusal can be appealed to the Data Protection Ombudsman.

fields.sentence: Tietosuojavaltuutettu voi määrätä rekisterinpitäjän noudattamaan pyyntöä.
fields.meaning: The Data Protection Ombudsman may order the controller to comply with the request.

fields.sentence: Tietosuojavaltuutetun päätökseen voi hakea muutosta hallinto-oikeudesta.
fields.meaning: The Data Protection Ombudsman's decision can be appealed to the administrative court.

fields.sentence: Hallinto-oikeuden päätökseen voi edelleen hakea muutosta korkeimmalta hallinto-oikeudelta.
fields.meaning: The administrative court's decision can be further appealed to the Supreme Administrative Court.

fields.sentence: Muutoksenhaku on mahdollista vain, jos korkein hallinto-oikeus myöntää valitusluvan.
fields.meaning: Appeal is only possible if the Supreme Administrative Court grants leave to appeal.

fields.sentence: Valituslupa myönnetään, jos asiassa on tärkeää ennakkopäätösarvoa.
fields.meaning: Leave to appeal is granted if the case has important precedential value.

fields.sentence: Ennakkopäätös on sitova alempia tuomioistuimia kohtaan.
fields.meaning: A precedent is binding on lower courts.
The precedents of the Supreme Court are the most important.

fields.sentence: Korkein oikeus käsittelee rikos- ja riita-asioita.
fields.meaning: The Supreme Court handles criminal and civil cases.
The Supreme Administrative Court handles administrative matters.
The independence of the judiciary is guaranteed by the constitution.

fields.sentence: Tuomioistuimet eivät saa noudattaa hallituksen ohjeita yksittäistapauksissa.
fields.meaning: Courts must not follow government instructions in individual cases.

fields.sentence: Tuomarin on oltava puolueeton ja esteetön.
fields.meaning: A judge must be impartial and free from disqualification.
The grounds for disqualification are defined by law.

fields.sentence: Tuomari voi jäävätä itsensä, jos on syytä epäillä puolueellisuutta.
fields.meaning: A judge may recuse themselves if there is reason to suspect bias.
A party may request the judge's disqualification.
A disqualification request is usually decided by another judge.

fields.sentence: Oikeudenkäynti on julkinen, ellei laissa toisin säädetä.
fields.meaning: Court proceedings are public unless otherwise provided by law.

fields.sentence: Julkisuus voidaan rajoittaa yksityisyyden tai turvallisuuden vuoksi.
fields.meaning: Publicity may be restricted for reasons of privacy or security.
A part of the proceedings may be ordered to be secret.

fields.sentence: Salaista osaa ei saa tallentaa eikä raportoida.
fields.meaning: The secret part must not be recorded or reported.
The judgment is always public.

fields.sentence: Tuomion perustelut ovat julkisia, vaikka käsittely olisi salainen.
fields.meaning: The grounds of the judgment are public even if the proceedings are secret.

fields.sentence: Tuomio on annettava viivytyksettä käsittelyn päätyttyä.
fields.meaning: The judgment must be given without delay after the proceedings end.
The judgment must be served on the parties.
Receiving service starts the appeal period.
The appeal period is generally 30 days.
The appeal period may be extended for a special reason.

fields.sentence: Valitus on tehtävä kirjallisesti valitusosoituksen mukaiselle viranomaiselle.
fields.meaning: An appeal must be made in writing to the authority indicated in the appeal instructions.

fields.sentence: Valituskirjelmässä on ilmoitettava, mihin päätökseen haetaan muutosta.
fields.meaning: The appeal document must state which decision is being appealed.
The appeal must present the claims and their grounds.

fields.sentence: Perusteet voivat olla oikeudellisia tai tosiseikkoihin liittyviä.
fields.meaning: The grounds may be legal or factual.
The appellant must sign the appeal document.

fields.sentence: Valituksen liitteenä on toimitettava alkuperäinen päätös.
fields.meaning: The original decision must be attached to the appeal.

fields.sentence: Liitteenä on myös toimitettava selvitys valitusajan alkamisesta.
fields.meaning: Evidence of the start of the appeal period must also be attached.
The appeal must be filed with the appellate authority within the deadline.
An appeal submitted after the deadline will be left unexamined.
One may apply for restoration for being late.

fields.sentence: Palautus voidaan myöntää, jos myöhästymiselle on hyväksyttävä syy.
fields.meaning: Restoration may be granted if there is an acceptable reason for the delay.

fields.sentence: Hyväksyttävä syy voi olla esimerkiksi sairaalaan joutuminen.
fields.meaning: An acceptable reason could be, for example, being hospitalized.

fields.sentence: Palautushakemus on tehtävä 30 päivän kuluessa esteen poistumisesta.
fields.meaning: An application for restoration must be made within 30 days of the obstacle being removed.
The restoration application must include evidence of the obstacle.

fields.sentence: Palautus voidaan evätä, jos syytä ei hyväksytä.
fields.meaning: Restoration may be denied if the reason is not accepted.
A denial decision can be appealed.
Appealability is an important legal remedy.

fields.sentence: Oikeusturvakeinoja ovat valitus, kantelu ja muutoksenhaku.
fields.meaning: Legal remedies include appeal, complaint, and other appeals.

fields.sentence: Kantelu on vapaamuotoinen, eikä siinä ole määräaikaa.
fields.meaning: A complaint is informal and has no deadline.

fields.sentence: Kantelu voidaan tehdä oikeusasiamiehelle tai oikeuskanslerille.
fields.meaning: A complaint can be made to the Parliamentary Ombudsman or the Chancellor of Justice.

fields.sentence: Kantelun perusteella ei voida muuttaa päätöstä, mutta voidaan antaa huomautus.
fields.meaning: A complaint cannot change a decision, but a reprimand may be given.

fields.sentence: Kantelu on tehokas tapa puuttua järjestelmällisiin epäkohtiin.
fields.meaning: A complaint is an effective way to address systemic deficiencies.
A complaint may lead to a preliminary investigation.

fields.sentence: Esitutkinta on poliisin tai syyttäjän suorittama selvitys.
fields.meaning: A preliminary investigation is an inquiry conducted by the police or prosecutor.
In a preliminary investigation, parties and witnesses are heard.
The preliminary investigation material is sent to the prosecutor.
The prosecutor decides whether to press charges.
The prosecutor may also issue a decision not to prosecute.
A decision not to prosecute can be appealed.
An appeal is made to the Prosecutor General.
The Prosecutor General may order charges to be pressed.
Pressing charges initiates a trial.
A criminal trial begins with the main hearing.

fields.sentence: Pääkäsittely on julkinen, ellei salassapidolle ole perustetta.
fields.meaning: The main hearing is public unless there is a reason for secrecy.
In the main hearing, witnesses and experts are heard.
Witnesses are obliged to tell the truth.

fields.sentence: Todistajan valheellinen kertomus on valaehtoinen todistus.
fields.meaning: A witness's false statement is perjury.
A false statement is a crime.

fields.sentence: Todistajaa voidaan rangaista, jos hän kieltäytyy todistamasta ilman laillista syytä.
fields.meaning: A witness may be punished if they refuse to testify without legal reason.
Close relatives have the right to refuse to testify.

fields.sentence: Lähiomaisia ovat puoliso, lapset, vanhemmat ja sisarukset.
fields.meaning: Close relatives include spouse, children, parents, and siblings.

fields.sentence: Todistajalla on myös oikeus kieltäytyä todistamasta, jos se paljastaisi ammattisalaisuuden.
fields.meaning: A witness also has the right to refuse to testify if it would reveal a professional secret.

fields.sentence: Ammattisalaisuus koskee esimerkiksi lääkäreitä, juristeja ja pappeja.
fields.meaning: Professional secrecy applies to, for example, doctors, lawyers, and clergy.

fields.sentence: Toimittajalla on oikeus olla paljastamatta lähdettään.
fields.meaning: A journalist has the right not to reveal their source.
Source protection is guaranteed in the constitution.

fields.sentence: Lähdesuojaa voidaan rajoittaa vain rikostutkinnassa painavasta syystä.
fields.meaning: Source protection may only be restricted in criminal investigations for a weighty reason.

fields.sentence: Painava syy voi olla esimerkiksi henkeen tai terveyteen kohdistuva uhka.
fields.meaning: A weighty reason could be, for example, a threat to life or health.
A court decides on restricting source protection.

fields.sentence: Tuomioistuin voi määrätä salassapidon, jos se on tarpeen tutkinnassa.
fields.meaning: The court may order non-disclosure if necessary for the investigation.
A non-disclosure order may be issued before the trial.

fields.sentence: Salassapitomääräys koskee vain tiettyä asiaa ja tiettyä ajanjaksoa.
fields.meaning: A non-disclosure order applies only to a specific matter and a specific period.
Violation of a non-disclosure order is punishable.

fields.sentence: Rangaistuksena voi olla sakko tai vankeutta.
fields.meaning: The penalty may be a fine or imprisonment.

fields.sentence: Vankeutta voidaan tuomita enintään kaksi vuotta.
fields.meaning: Imprisonment may be imposed for a maximum of two years.
A fine is a milder sanction.
The amount of the fine depends on income level.
A day fine is calculated based on net income.

fields.sentence: Yksi päiväsakko on vähintään 6 euroa, enintään 120 euroa.
fields.meaning: One day fine is at least 6 euros, at most 120 euros.

fields.sentence: Sakko voidaan muuntaa vankeudeksi, jos sitä ei makseta.
fields.meaning: A fine can be converted to imprisonment if not paid.

fields.sentence: Muuntoa ei kuitenkaan käytetä, jos sakko on alhainen.
fields.meaning: However, conversion is not used if the fine is low.
A conversion sentence is at most three months.

fields.sentence: Muuntorangaistus voidaan määrätä vain, jos sakkoa ei saada perityksi.
fields.meaning: A conversion sentence may only be imposed if the fine cannot be collected.
A payment period may be granted for paying a fine.
The payment period is at most two years.
A fine becomes statute-barred after five years.

fields.sentence: Vanhentumisaika voi olla pidempi, jos sakko on tuomittu törkeästä rikoksesta.
fields.meaning: The limitation period may be longer if the fine is imposed for a serious crime.
The limitation period for a serious crime is 10–20 years.
Statute-barred prevents the enforcement of the penalty.
The commencement of enforcement of the penalty interrupts the limitation period.

fields.sentence: Vanhentumisen keskeyttää myös se, että tuomittu oleskelee ulkomailla.
fields.meaning: Limitation is also interrupted if the convicted person resides abroad.

fields.sentence: Ulkomailla oleskelu keskeyttää vanhentumisen enintään viideksi vuodeksi.
fields.meaning: Residence abroad interrupts limitation for a maximum of five years.
Limitation is regulated in the Criminal Code.

fields.sentence: Rikoslain mukaan rikokset vanhenevat eri aikoina rikoksen vakavuudesta riippuen.
fields.meaning: According to the Criminal Code, crimes become statute-barred at different times depending on the severity of the crime.
Minor crimes become statute-barred more quickly.
Theft becomes statute-barred in five years.
Aggravated tax fraud becomes statute-barred in ten years.
Murder never becomes statute-barred.

fields.sentence: Murhan tutkinta voidaan aloittaa vuosikymmentenkin jälkeen.
fields.meaning: An investigation into murder can be initiated even decades later.
However, initiating an investigation requires evidence.
Evidence may weaken over time.
Investigation of a statute-barred crime may be discontinued.
A decision to discontinue cannot be appealed.

fields.sentence: Keskeyttäminen ei kuitenkaan estä uutta tutkintaa, jos ilmenee uutta näyttöä.
fields.meaning: However, discontinuation does not prevent a new investigation if new evidence emerges.

fields.sentence: Uusi näyttö voi olla esimerkiksi DNA-todiste.
fields.meaning: New evidence could be, for example, DNA evidence.

fields.sentence: DNA-todisteiden säilyvyys on parantunut tekniikan kehittyessä.
fields.meaning: The preservation of DNA evidence has improved with advancing technology.

fields.sentence: Tekniikan kehitys on auttanut selvittämään vanhojakin rikoksia.
fields.meaning: Technological development has helped solve even old crimes.

fields.sentence: Kylmät tapaukset ratkeavat joskus vuosikymmenten jälkeen.
fields.meaning: Cold cases are sometimes solved decades later.

fields.sentence: Ratkaisu voi tuoda helpotusta uhrien omaisille.
fields.meaning: A resolution can bring relief to the victims' families.

fields.sentence: Omaisilla on oikeus saada tieto tutkinnan etenemisestä.
fields.meaning: Relatives have the right to be informed about the progress of the investigation.
The right to information is part of victims' rights.
The Victims' Rights Directive has strengthened the position of victims.

fields.sentence: Uhrilla on oikeus tukeen ja neuvontaan.
fields.meaning: The victim has the right to support and advice.
Support is provided by the victim support service.
Victim support is free of charge.
Victim support may also provide therapy.

fields.sentence: Terapia on tarkoitettu erityisesti väkivaltarikosten uhreille.
fields.meaning: Therapy is especially intended for victims of violent crimes.

fields.sentence: Väkivaltarikos voi aiheuttaa pitkäaikaisia psyykkisiä oireita.
fields.meaning: A violent crime can cause long-term psychological symptoms.

fields.sentence: Oireita voivat olla ahdistus, masennus ja univaikeudet.
fields.meaning: Symptoms may include anxiety, depression, and sleep difficulties.
The victim is entitled to receive crisis assistance.
Crisis assistance is quickly available.

fields.sentence: Kriisiapua antaa usein sosiaali- tai terveysasema.
fields.meaning: Crisis assistance is often provided by a social or health station.
Crisis assistance can also be provided by phone.
The crisis hotline is open 24/7.
You can call the crisis hotline anonymously.
Anonymity encourages people to get in touch.
Help is also available online.
Online crisis support is a low-threshold service.

fields.sentence: Matalan kynnyksen palveluihin on helppo hakeutua.
fields.meaning: Low-threshold services are easy to access.

fields.sentence: Matalan kynnyksen palveluja ovat esimerkiksi nuorisotilat ja avoimet kohtaamispaikat.
fields.meaning: Low-threshold services include, for example, youth centers and open meeting places.
Open meeting places prevent social exclusion.
Preventing social exclusion is a societal task.
Social exclusion can lead to crime.
Crime, in turn, increases social exclusion.
The cycle is difficult to break.
Prevention is the most effective means.

fields.sentence: Ennaltaehkäisevää työtä tehdään kouluissa, nuorisotyössä ja sosiaalitoimessa.
fields.meaning: Preventive work is done in schools, youth work, and social services.
Multidisciplinary cooperation is important.

fields.sentence: Monialainen yhteistyö tarkoittaa eri viranomaisten ja toimijoiden välistä yhteistyötä.
fields.meaning: Multidisciplinary cooperation means collaboration between different authorities and actors.

fields.sentence: Yhteistyötä tehdään myös kolmannen sektorin kanssa.
fields.meaning: Cooperation is also carried out with the third sector.
The third sector complements public services.

fields.sentence: Kolmannen sektorin toimijoita ovat esimerkiksi järjestöt ja säätiöt.
fields.meaning: Third sector actors include, for example, associations and foundations.

fields.sentence: Järjestöt saavat usein avustuksia julkiselta sektorilta.
fields.meaning: Associations often receive grants from the public sector.
Grants cover operating costs.
Applying for grants is competitive.
The grant application must be submitted by the deadline.

fields.sentence: Määräajan ylitys johtaa yleensä hakemuksen hylkäämiseen.
fields.meaning: Missing the deadline usually leads to rejection of the application.
A rejection decision can be appealed.
An appeal must be made within 30 days.

fields.sentence: Muutoksenhaku tehdään yleensä samalle viranomaiselle, joka on tehnyt päätöksen.
fields.meaning: An appeal is usually made to the same authority that made the decision.

fields.sentence: Viranomainen voi muuttaa päätöstään oikaisuvaatimuksen johdosta.
fields.meaning: The authority may change its decision following a request for rectification.
A request for rectification is free and simple.
A request for rectification must be answered within a reasonable time.

fields.sentence: Kohtuullinen aika on yleensä kolme kuukautta.
fields.meaning: A reasonable time is generally three months.

fields.sentence: Jos vastausta ei tule, voidaan tehdä kantelu.
fields.meaning: If there is no response, a complaint can be made.
A complaint is made to the Parliamentary Ombudsman.
The Ombudsman may issue a reprimand to the authority.
A reprimand is a mild sanction.

fields.sentence: Vakavammissa tapauksissa oikeusasiamies voi esittää syytteen.
fields.meaning: In more serious cases, the Ombudsman may press charges.
Charges may lead to a conviction for official misconduct.

fields.sentence: Virkarikoksesta voidaan tuomita sakkoa tai vankeutta.
fields.meaning: Official misconduct can lead to a fine or imprisonment.

fields.sentence: Virkarikos on rikos, jonka virkamies tekee virka-asemassaan.
fields.meaning: Official misconduct is a crime committed by a public official in their official capacity.

fields.sentence: Virkamies on erityisasemassa, koska hän käyttää julkista valtaa.
fields.meaning: A public official is in a special position because they exercise public power.

fields.sentence: Julkisen vallan käyttöön liittyy suuri vastuu.
fields.meaning: The exercise of public power involves great responsibility.

fields.sentence: Vastuuseen kuuluu myös hyvän hallinnon periaatteiden noudattaminen.
fields.meaning: Responsibility also includes following the principles of good administration.

fields.sentence: Hyvän hallinnon periaatteita ovat muun muassa tasapuolisuus ja neuvonta.
fields.meaning: The principles of good administration include, among others, impartiality and advice.

fields.sentence: Neuvontavelvollisuus tarkoittaa, että viranomaisen on opastettava asiakasta.
fields.meaning: The duty to advise means that the authority must guide the customer.

fields.sentence: Asiakasta on neuvottava, miten asiassa tulee menetellä.
fields.meaning: The customer must be advised on how to proceed in the matter.
Advice must be given in an understandable form.

fields.sentence: Neuvonta voidaan antaa kirjallisesti tai suullisesti.
fields.meaning: Advice may be given in writing or orally.
Oral advice is often faster.
Written advice is more binding.

fields.sentence: Viranomainen voi joutua vastuuseen, jos antaa virheellistä neuvontaa.
fields.meaning: An authority may be held liable if they provide incorrect advice.
Incorrect advice can lead to damages.

fields.sentence: Vahingonkorvaus on mahdollinen, jos neuvonta on aiheuttanut taloudellista vahinkoa.
fields.meaning: Compensation is possible if the advice has caused financial loss.
Liability for damages requires fault.
Fault is negligence or omission.

fields.sentence: Tuottamus voi olla lievää, törkeää tai tahallista.
fields.meaning: Fault may be slight, gross, or intentional.
Intentional fault is the most serious.

fields.sentence: Tahallisuus tarkoittaa, että seuraus on haluttu tai ainakin hyväksytty.
fields.meaning: Intent means that the consequence was desired or at least accepted.
Acceptance often manifests as indifference.
Indifference is a sign of recklessness.
Recklessness can lead to serious consequences.
Serious consequences include, for example, imprisonment.

fields.sentence: Vankeusrangaistus voidaan määrätä ehdollisena tai ehdottomana.
fields.meaning: Imprisonment may be imposed as conditional or unconditional.

fields.sentence: Ehdollinen vankeusrangaistus tarkoittaa, että tuomittu ei joudu vankilaan, jos hän ei syyllisty uuteen rikokseen.
fields.meaning: Conditional imprisonment means that the convicted person does not go to prison if they do not commit a new crime.

fields.sentence: Ehdollisen vankeusrangaistuksen koeaika on yleensä kaksi vuotta.
fields.meaning: The probation period for conditional imprisonment is usually two years.
During the probation period, the convicted person is under supervision.
Supervision may be intensified.

fields.sentence: Tehostettu valvonta tarkoittaa tiheämpiä tapaamisia ja tarkempia raportteja.
fields.meaning: Intensified supervision means more frequent meetings and more detailed reports.
Intensified supervision is used for those belonging to a risk group.
Risk groups include, for example, those with substance abuse problems.
Substance abuse is often a cause of crime.
Treatment is available for substance abuse.

fields.sentence: Hoito voidaan määrätä myös rikosprosessin yhteydessä.
fields.meaning: Treatment may also be ordered in connection with criminal proceedings.
Ordering treatment requires a court decision.
The court may also order community service.
Community service is an alternative to imprisonment.
Community service may be ordered for a maximum of 240 hours.
Community service is usually done in a charity organization.

fields.sentence: Yhdyskuntapalvelu on raskasta, mutta se ei rajoita vapautta yhtä paljon kuin vankeus.
fields.meaning: Community service is demanding, but it does not restrict freedom as much as imprisonment.

fields.sentence: Yhdyskuntapalvelun suorittamatta jättäminen voi johtaa vankeusrangaistukseen.
fields.meaning: Failure to complete community service may lead to imprisonment.
Imprisonment is a last resort.
The purpose of imprisonment is also to rehabilitate.

fields.sentence: Kuntoutus vankilassa sisältää työtä, opiskelua ja terapiaa.
fields.meaning: Rehabilitation in prison includes work, study, and therapy.
Work in prison is often monotonous.
Monotonous work is not motivating.
Motivation is important for rehabilitation.

fields.sentence: Kuntoutumisen edellytyksenä on vangin oma halu.
fields.meaning: A prerequisite for rehabilitation is the inmate's own desire.

fields.sentence: Ilman omaa halua kuntoutus ei onnistu.
fields.meaning: Without one's own desire, rehabilitation does not succeed.
Successful rehabilitation reduces recidivism.
Recidivism is common in certain types of crime.
Recidivism is sought to be reduced by aftercare.

fields.sentence: Jälkihuolto tarkoittaa tukea vankilasta vapautumisen jälkeen.
fields.meaning: Aftercare means support after release from prison.

fields.sentence: Jälkihuoltoon kuuluu asunnon, työn ja toimeentulon järjestäminen.
fields.meaning: Aftercare includes arranging housing, work, and livelihood.
Aftercare aims to prevent social exclusion.
Preventing social exclusion is in society's interest.
Society's interest is to reduce crime.
Reducing crime saves society's resources.
Society's resources can be used for prevention.
Prevention is cost-effective.

fields.sentence: Kustannustehokkuus on tärkeä periaate julkisessa taloudessa.
fields.meaning: Cost-effectiveness is an important principle in public finance.
Public finances are burdened by many expenditures.
Expenditures must be covered by taxes.
Tax revenues form the basis of the state budget.
The state budget is approved in Parliament.
The budget includes revenues and expenditures.
Budget implementation is monitored through the financial statement.
The financial statement is given to Parliament.
Parliament reviews the financial statement in the Finance Committee.
The Finance Committee gives a statement on the financial statement.
The statement may contain criticism.
Criticism may lead to government action.

fields.sentence: Hallitus voi joutua tekemään muutoksia budjettiin.
fields.meaning: The government may have to make changes to the budget.
Budget changes are made through a supplementary budget.
The supplementary budget is processed in Parliament on an accelerated basis.

fields.sentence: Nopeutettu käsittely on tarpeen yllättävissä tilanteissa.
fields.meaning: Accelerated processing is necessary in unexpected situations.

fields.sentence: Yllättäviä tilanteita ovat esimerkiksi pandemia tai sota.
fields.meaning: Unexpected situations include, for example, a pandemic or war.
The pandemic caused major changes in society.
Society is still recovering from the pandemic.

fields.sentence: Toipuminen on ollut hitaampaa kuin odotettiin.
fields.meaning: Recovery has been slower than expected.

fields.sentence: Odotukset toipumisen nopeudesta olivat liian optimistisia.
fields.meaning: Expectations about the speed of recovery were too optimistic.

fields.sentence: Optimismi on usein tarpeen, mutta realiteetit on tunnustettava.
fields.meaning: Optimism is often necessary, but realities must be acknowledged.
Acknowledging realities helps in planning.

fields.sentence: Suunnittelu on tärkeää sekä yksityisellä että julkisella sektorilla.
fields.meaning: Planning is important in both the private and public sectors.
Planning reduces uncertainty.
Uncertainty is inevitable in a complex world.
Complexity requires flexibility.

fields.sentence: Joustavuus on tärkeä ominaisuus niin yksilölle kuin organisaatiollekin.
fields.meaning: Flexibility is an important quality for both individuals and organizations.
Organizational flexibility requires an open culture.

fields.sentence: Avoin kulttuuri rohkaisee kokeiluihin ja innovaatioihin.
fields.meaning: An open culture encourages experimentation and innovation.
Innovations are the basis of competitiveness.
Competitiveness is important in international trade.
International trade brings prosperity.
However, prosperity is not distributed evenly.
Uneven distribution causes dissatisfaction.
Dissatisfaction can lead to political upheavals.
Political upheavals are often unpredictable.
Unpredictability makes forecasting difficult.
However, forecasting is necessary in planning.

fields.sentence: Suunnittelussa on varauduttava myös heikkoihin signaaleihin.
fields.meaning: Planning must also prepare for weak signals.

fields.sentence: Heikot signaalit ovat varhaisia merkkejä tulevista muutoksista.
fields.meaning: Weak signals are early signs of future changes.
Identifying weak signals requires sensitivity.
Sensitivity is also important in human relationships.

fields.sentence: Ihmissuhteet ovat monimutkaisia ja vaativat hoivaa.
fields.meaning: Human relationships are complex and require care.

fields.sentence: Hoivaa tarvitaan erityisesti silloin, kun ihmissuhde on kriisissä.
fields.meaning: Care is especially needed when a relationship is in crisis.
In a crisis, it is important to stay calm.
Calmness helps find solutions.
Solutions are not always easy.
Difficult solutions require courage.
Courage is valued in all areas of life.
However, respect must be earned.
Achievement requires long-term work.
Long-term commitment is a rare virtue.

fields.sentence: Hyveitä on monia, ja ne vaihtelevat kulttuureittain.
fields.meaning: There are many virtues, and they vary by culture.
Cultural differences can cause misunderstandings.
Misunderstandings are common in international work.
International work requires cultural sensitivity.
Cultural sensitivity helps avoid conflicts.

fields.sentence: Konfliktit ovat väistämättömiä, mutta niitä voi hallita.
fields.meaning: Conflicts are inevitable, but they can be managed.

fields.sentence: Konfliktin hallinta on tärkeä taito johtajalle.
fields.meaning: Conflict management is an important skill for a leader.
A leader must be fair.
Fairness increases trust.
Trust is the foundation of an organization's success.
However, success is not an end in itself.
Self-purposefulness can lead to unethical behavior.
Unethical behavior damages reputation.
Restoring a reputation is difficult.
Difficult, but not impossible.
Impossibility is often a matter of attitude.
Attitude makes a big difference.

fields.sentence: Paljon on kiinni siitä, miten asioihin suhtautuu.
fields.meaning: Much depends on how one approaches things.
The approach affects the outcome.
The outcome does not always meet expectations.
Expectations should be kept realistic.
Realistic expectations reduce disappointment.
Disappointment is part of life.
Life also has reasons for joy.
Joy should be shared with others.
Sharing increases joy.
Increased joy improves well-being.

fields.sentence: Hyvinvointi on tärkeää yksilölle ja yhteiskunnalle.
fields.meaning: Well-being is important for individuals and society.
Society's task is to promote well-being.
Promoting well-being is multifaceted.
Multifaceted problems require broad solutions.
Broad solutions require cooperation.

fields.sentence: Yhteistyö eri sektoreiden välillä on haasteellista.
fields.meaning: Cooperation between different sectors is challenging.
Despite the challenges, cooperation is necessary.
Necessity forces action.

fields.sentence: Toiminta voi olla hidasta byrokratian takia.
fields.meaning: Action can be slow due to bureaucracy.

fields.sentence: Byrokratia on usein tarpeellista, mutta sitä tulisi keventää.
fields.meaning: Bureaucracy is often necessary, but it should be lightened.
Lightening is possible through digitalization.
Digitalization changes bureaucracy profoundly.
Profound changes take time.
Sufficient time must be used.

fields.sentence: Riittävä aika on tärkeää muutoksen onnistumiselle.
fields.meaning: Sufficient time is important for the success of change.
Success requires commitment.
Commitment is long-term.
Long-term commitment produces results.
Results can be difficult to measure.
Measurement is important for evaluation.
Evaluation helps develop operations.
Developing operations is a continuous process.
A continuous process requires resources.

fields.sentence: Resurssit ovat rajallisia, joten priorisointi on välttämätöntä.
fields.meaning: Resources are limited, so prioritization is necessary.

fields.sentence: Priorisointi on vaikeaa, koska kaikki vaikuttaa tärkeältä.

Objective grounds reduce arbitrariness.
Arbitrariness must be avoided in decision-making.

fields.sentence: Päätöksenteko on sitä helpompaa, mitä enemmän tietoa on.
fields.meaning: Decision-making is easier the more information is available.
However, there is often too much information.
Too much information can paralyze.
Paralysis is a known phenomenon in decision-making.
The known phenomenon is called analysis paralysis.

fields.sentence: Analyysihalvaus tarkoittaa kyvyttömyyttä tehdä päätös liian monen vaihtoehdon takia.
fields.meaning: Analysis paralysis means the inability to make a decision due to too many options.
Too many options reduce satisfaction.
However, satisfaction is important for well-being.

fields.sentence: Hyvinvointi ei ole sama asia kuin onnellisuus.
fields.meaning: Well-being is not the same as happiness.
Happiness is subjective.
Subjective experiences vary greatly.
Large variation makes comparison difficult.

fields.sentence: Vaikeasta vertailusta huolimatta tutkimus on mahdollista.
fields.meaning: Despite difficult comparison, research is possible.
Possible research helps understand phenomena.
Understanding phenomena is the goal of science.
Science is a central part of civilization.

fields.sentence: Sivistys on enemmän kuin tiedon määrä.
fields.meaning: Civilization is more than the amount of knowledge.
The amount of knowledge grows exponentially.
Exponential growth makes knowledge management difficult.
Knowledge management is increasingly important.
The quality of knowledge is also important.
High-quality knowledge is reliable.
Reliable knowledge is the basis for decision-making.

fields.sentence: Päätöksenteko ilman luotettavaa tietoa on arpapeliä.
fields.meaning: Decision-making without reliable knowledge is a gamble.

fields.sentence: Arpapeliä ei voida hyväksyä julkisessa hallinnossa.
fields.meaning: Gambling cannot be accepted in public administration.
Public administration is based on law.
The law is democratically approved.
Democratic approval gives the law legitimacy.
Legitimacy is important for social peace.
Social peace is a fragile thing.
Fragile peace must be protected.
Protection is everyone's responsibility.

fields.sentence: Vastuu ei ole pelkästään viranomaisten harteilla.
fields.meaning: Responsibility is not solely on the shoulders of authorities.
Citizens also have responsibility.

fields.sentence: Vastuullinen kansalainen noudattaa lakeja ja osallistuu.
fields.meaning: A responsible citizen obeys laws and participates.
Participation is a lifeline of democracy.

fields.sentence: Demokratia ei toimi ilman aktiivisia kansalaisia.
fields.meaning: Democracy does not work without active citizens.
There are fewer and fewer active citizens.
The decrease is a worrying trend.

fields.sentence: Huolestuttava suuntaus on havaittu monissa maissa.
fields.meaning: A worrying trend has been observed in many countries.
Many countries are trying to increase participation.
Increasing participation is challenging.
A challenging task requires creativity.
Creativity is a valuable resource.
Resources must be used wisely.
Wise use requires planning.
Planning is the key to success.
Success is not an accident.
However, chance can help.
Luck can also help.

fields.sentence: Onni on sattumaa, jota kutsutaan onneksi.
fields.meaning: Luck is chance that is called luck.
Fortunately, there is also willpower.
Willpower can overcome many obstacles.

fields.sentence: Esteet ovat usein vain mielikuvituksen tuotetta.
fields.meaning: Obstacles are often just a product of imagination.

fields.sentence: Mielikuvitus on sekä lahja että taakka.
fields.meaning: Imagination is both a gift and a burden.

fields.sentence: Taakka voi muuttua lahjaksi, jos sitä oppii käyttämään.
fields.meaning: A burden can become a gift if you learn to use it.
Learning to use takes time.
Time is a valuable resource.
Wasting resources is senseless.
Senseless action should be avoided.
Avoidance is wise.
Wisdom comes through experience.
Experience is the best teacher.
The teacher can also be harsh.
Despite the harshness, experience is valuable.
Valuable experience is worth its weight in gold.

fields.sentence: Kullan arvoinen on myös hyvä neuvo.
fields.meaning: Good advice is also worth its weight in gold.
Good advice is worth taking.
Receiving is openness.
Openness is important in learning.
Learning is a lifelong process.
The process continues until death.
Death is inevitable.
Inevitability must be accepted.
Acceptance brings peace of mind.
Peace of mind is important for health.
Health is the greatest wealth.
Wealth does not make one happy.
Happiness is often found in small things.
Small things are the salt of life.
Salt is an important spice.
Spices make food delicious.
Delicious food lifts the spirits.
Lifting the spirits is important.
It is also important to rest enough.
Adequate rest restores strength.
Strength is needed in everyday chores.
Everyday chores are important.
The most important, however, are human relationships.
Human relationships give life meaning.
Meaning is subjective.
Subjective meaning varies.
Variation is richness.
Richness is diversity.
Diversity must be protected.
Protection is our common cause.
A common cause unites people.

fields.sentence: Ihmiset voivat yhdessä saavuttaa suuria asioita.
fields.meaning: People can achieve great things together.
Great things start with small deeds.
Small deeds are meaningful.
Meaningfulness motivates one to continue.

fields.sentence: Jatkaminen on tärkeää, vaikka tulos ei näy heti.
fields.meaning: Continuing is important even if the result is not immediately visible.
Immediately visible results are rare.
Rarity makes them valuable.
Valuable things deserve waiting.
Waiting is often rewarding.
A rewarding experience stays in memory.

We are also shaped by disappointments.
Disappointments teach humility.
Humility is a valued quality.
A quality worth cherishing.

Self-knowledge is the key to spiritual growth.
Spiritual growth is a lifelong journey.
The journey has ups and downs.

Instructive experiences strengthen.
Strengthening is important for survival.
Survival is a basic human need.
Satisfaction of basic needs enables development.
Development is natural for humans.
A natural tendency is to strive forward.
Striving forward is human strength.
Strength must be used wisely.
Wise use benefits everyone.
Everyone benefits from cooperation.
Cooperation is effective.
Efficiency is worth striving for.
The most important value is honesty.
Honesty is the basis of trust.
Trust is the glue of society.
The glue holds society together.
Staying together is important in crises.
Crises test society's resilience.
Resilience must be built in advance.
Building in advance is wisdom.
Wisdom is the fruit of experience.

fields.sentence: Hedelmä on makea, mutta vaatii aikaa kypsyäkseen.

Ripening cannot be rushed.
Rushing ruins the fruit.
Spoiled fruit is useless.
Useless must be removed.
Removal makes room for the new.
The new is always an opportunity.
The opportunity must be seized.
Seizing requires courage.
Courage is often rewarded.
A reward is the best incentive.
An incentive creates movement.
Movement is life.
Life is movement.
There is power in movement.
Power must be used for good.
Using for good is ethical.
Ethics is a guideline.
A guideline helps in choices.
Choices shape life.
Life is full of choices.
Choices make us human.
Humanity is unique.
Uniqueness must be protected.
Protection is our responsibility.
Responsibility has been given to us.

Bearing is sometimes heavy.

Importance motivates perseverance.
Perseverance is rewarded.

An internal reward is lasting.
Lasting is valuable.
A valuable thing is worth preserving.
Preserving is wise.
Wisdom is more important than knowledge.

Great people do not boast about themselves.
Self-promotion is weakness.
Weakness is human.
Humanity is a unifying factor.
A unifying factor is important.
An important thing must be noted.
Noting is politeness.
Politeness is gold.
Gold is valuable but rare.
Rarity increases value.

Money is just a tool.
The tool is for a purpose.

Protection is valuable.
Valuable protection deserves thanks.

Acts are evaluated, words as well.
Evaluation is important for development.

Usefulness is more important than comfort.

Misleadingness is dangerous.
Dangerousness is to be avoided.
Avoiding is wise.
Wisdom is the best protection.
Protection is needed in life.
Life is valuable but fragile.
Fragility makes it valuable.
Value must be respected.
Respect is reciprocal.
Reciprocity is the basis of fairness.
Fairness is justice.
Justice is the foundation of society.

Cherishing is continuous work.
Work is rewarding but demanding.
Demanding work builds character.
Character is more important than reputation.

fields.sentence: Maine on sitä, mitä muut ajattelevat.
fields.meaning: Reputation is what others think.

Appearing is superficial.
Superficiality is a waste of time.
Wasting time is not worth it.

Simplicity is beauty.
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

Typicality does not make it good.

Atypicality is valuable.
Value is rare.
Rarity is relative.
Relativity is important to understand.
Understanding requires effort.
Effort always pays off.

Strengthening is the task of diplomacy.
